result.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens returns the parent-app response when credential sharing is enabled, with only a comment saying 'The response should only contain the access token and expiry date' — no field names or units. Meanwhile each adapter parses that response against app-specific schemas: Google's googleCredentialSchema expects `expiry_date` (ms), Office365 uses refreshTokenResponseSchema (expires_in seconds), Lark/Teams/Webex use their own `expiry_date` fields. So no single parent-endpoint response can satisfy all adapters' parse steps, plausibly breaking token refresh for synced apps
